_meta.purpose: Legality-pinning conformance vectors. Each vector lists EVERY legal play; a conforming engine must return one of them. Strength is never asserted — a weak but legal engine passes.
_meta.playKey: order-independent multiset of from/to steps, joined by comma, sorted. from 0 = bar, to 0 = off.
_meta.source: data/reference/gnubg-2ply-refset.json (positions only; gnubg equities NOT used)
